packageRules.description: The compose file is for people to copy, so it follows the app's own latest tag instead of a digest that goes stale every build
The frontend patch has to be checked against every new Excalidraw commit, so a commit update waits for that instead of merging itself.

customManagers.description: The Excalidraw commit the image builds, followed on upstream's master branch. The shared pattern cannot hold a bare commit, which git-refs reads as a digest.
